metadata.name: Definition
metadata.description: Declares a resource kind: the lifecycle role it implements, its configuration schema, observed state, input and output contracts, the errors it throws, and how it runs — a controller, a body of resources it dispatches to, or a parent kind it specializes.

capability.title: Capability
capability.description: The lifecycle role this kind implements.

extends.title: Extends
extends.description: The kind this one specializes, as `<Alias>.<Kind>` — an abstract it implements or a concrete kind whose controller it inherits.

controllers.title: Controllers
controllers.description: Package URLs of the controller implementations, in preference order.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Configuration this kind accepts, as JSON Schema plus `x-telo-*` annotations.

status.title: Observed state
status.description: What a resource of this kind reports while running, published at `resources.<name>.status.<field>`.

inputType.title: Input type
inputType.description: The schema of the inputs a call passes — a `!ref` to a named shape, or inline JSON Schema.

outputType.title: Output type
outputType.description: The schema of what a call returns — a `!ref` to a named shape, or inline JSON Schema.

deterministic.title: Deterministic
deterministic.description: `true` when the result depends only on the arguments and this instance's configuration. Legal on a callable kind that declares its own `controllers:` (a claim) or on a callable abstract (a requirement every implementation must meet).

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: How a visual editor draws resources of this kind.

invoke.title: Invoke target
invoke.description: The `resources:` entry whose `invoke()` this kind dispatches to, as `!ref <entry>`.

provide.title: Provide target
provide.description: The `resources:` entry whose `invoke()` produces this provider's value, as `!ref <entry>`.

run.title: Run target
run.description: The `resources:` entry whose `run()` this kind dispatches to, as `!ref <entry>`.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The `resources:` entries this kind starts, in order, when an instance runs — each as `!ref <entry>`, each a Telo.Service or Telo.Runnable. Replaces `run:` when the kind has more than one thing to start, such as a server and the poller beside it.

mount.title: Mount target
mount.description: The `resources:` entry (a Telo.Mount, e.g. an Http.Api) whose `register()` this kind delegates to, as `!ref <entry>`.
